title: Tunable M-Ary Quantum Secure Direct Communication via Correlation-Histogram Modulation
summary: We propose a two-way entanglement-based quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) protocol in which information is encoded as the value of a continuously tunable parameter and decoded from empirically estimated joint-outcome histograms over windows of detected pairs.
